expects.rule: The homepage says why the event exists, what attendees gain and who should come.
A Register or Tickets button sits in the same place on every page. Long registration forms are split into steps, such as contact details then payment, to reduce abandonment.
Photographs come from the event itself, taken by a photographer, not from stock libraries.
The detailed schedule gives session titles, speaker names and bios, rooms, the venue address with a map link and lodging options.
Date, city and venue are in the first screen and in the page title, as in the listed sites.
Ticket prices and the deadline for each price are shown before the buyer reaches the form.
The line-up or programme is real text that can be searched and read on a phone, not a poster image.
After the event the site keeps the date, a recap and a way to join the next edition instead of staying on a dead Buy tickets button.

traits: A date is on the first screen on 5 of 8 (OFFFForum, Design Bomb, Kelvin, Hack the North, Francouvertes); 2 show only a preloader on capture and Lago Lago is covered by a consent panel.
A ticket or pass button is in the header or first screen on 5 of 8 (OFFFForum, Design Bomb, Kelvin, Lago Lago, ShapeShift text).
The event name is the largest element, set between 52 and 160 px or as a logo spanning the width, on 6 of 8 captures.
Photography of people is the background on 3 of 8 (OFFFForum, Lago Lago, Kelvin's thermal portrait); 2 use illustration (Hack the North, Francouvertes); Design Bomb uses type and stickers only.
4 of 8 use a heavy or condensed display face for the name (PP Frama italic, League Gothic, Castledown, Kelvin's tall condensed) with a plain sans for the details.
A strong accent set against black or cream: pink on black (Design Bomb), gradient on cream (Kelvin), orange on black (Francouvertes), blue on white (Creative Cruise).
2 of 8 (ShapeShift, Creative Cruise) show only a preloader at capture time, which hides the date and the ticket action until it ends.

sites.name: OFFFForum
sites.why: Full-screen blurred photograph of attendees in a hall; 'OFFF FORUM' in a large logo/serif, a boxed table of dates (Forum Sept 15, OFFF Sept 16-17, 2027) and venue (SAT), a headline in capitals with the date and Montréal, and a white 'Get your forum ticket' pill. Cookie box lower right.

sites.name: Design Bomb Festival
sites.why: Black (#141414) page filled by 'DESIGN BOMB!!!' in a heavy italic sans (PP Frama) in off-white, a collage sticker with the dates 22-24 maggio, Catania, a pair of cartoon eyes, a pink TICKET button in a five-item menu. No photograph. Italian labels.

sites.name: Kelvin Music Festival 2027
sites.why: Cream (#f1ede4) page: giant letters KELVIN in a thin condensed face filled with a red-to-blue gradient, a thermal-camera portrait in the centre, a black date block (23-25 July 2027, Centrale Noord, Rotterdam), a two-line intro with 'Get passes' and 'See the lineup'. Hubot Sans.

sites.name: Hack the North
sites.why: Illustrated mountain landscape and a wooden table with a map and objects (record player, camera, cassette); the name in red-orange at 52 px in Castledown, dates 18-20 September 2026, 'applications are closed' line, menu of six items with social icons. Light blue and orange, no photograph.

sites.name: SHAPESHIFT FESTIVAL 2026
sites.why: On capture only a grey (#e9e9e9) preloader with a pixel square and the line 'initialising the human'; page text lists schedule, lineup, about, a grid tool, talks, exhibitions, workshops, screenings and a regular full pass at EUR 60 (not seen beyond the preloader).

sites.name: Lago Lago
sites.why: Full-bleed photograph of a crowd with raised arms at an outdoor festival by water, a large serif letter set in light pink, two outlined buttons (tickets, newsletter) at right; a Cookiebot panel covers the centre. Headline 'Ci vediamo a Lago Lago 2027' in Satoshi light at 70 px.

sites.name: Creative Cruise 2026
sites.why: On capture only a white loading screen with a 3D boat and a blue percentage counter; the page after loading has a five-item menu (Home, About, Behind, Sign Up, Not Invited?) set in BW Gradual, blue (#065abf) text on white (not seen beyond the loader).

sites.name: Festival Les Francouvertes
sites.why: Black page with a floating rounded header (SiriusXM presents, Francouvertes logo, orange 'Concours' button), an illustration of a leg in a yellow shoe, '31e Francouvertes, du 8 mai' in a tall condensed grey face (League Gothic); a consent panel covers the right. Inter for text.

avoid: A hero with only the event name and a countdown, with no date written as text and no city.
Programme published only as a PDF or an image: it cannot be read on a phone or by a screen reader.
A ticket button that changes place or wording between pages.
Stock photographs of audiences and handshakes in place of the venue, speakers or the previous edition.
Full-page animation that delays the date, the line-up and the ticket link.
A site left online after the event still saying Buy tickets.

sources.name: Mighty Citizen, Five and a Half Fundamentals for Every Conference Website
